title: Operational Procurement Manager - VR
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**

  

  

Imagine starting your day as an Operational Procurement Manager in a vibrant product manufacturing environment! You will kick off by reviewing inventory levels, purchase orders, and supplier delivery schedules to proactively identify potential issues or delays. By evaluating production needs, you will help avoid material shortages and coordinate updates on material lead times while monitoring safety stock levels to ensure uninterrupted operations. Collaborating closely with internal teams like production and logistics, you will address procurement needs and streamline workflows. Throughout the day, you will analyze procurement data to monitor supplier performance and manage inventory replenishment, all while implementing procurement strategies that align with our business objectives to ensure cost efficiency and supply continuity.

 **How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Lead the operational procurement team to ensure timely sourcing and delivery of all components, aligned with production schedules and demand.
* Collaborate closely with the group to address challenges, update material schedules, and ensure MRP systems accurately reflect forecasts and product demand.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams locally and globally to drive innovation and enhance efficiency in supply chain operations.
* Monitor and manage inventory levels to guarantee on\-time deliveries that meet customer requirements and expectations.
* Foster professional and consistent supplier relationships to ensure reliability, quality, and alignment with business objectives.
* Design and implement creative, innovative processes for material planning and procurement to optimize performance and drive continuous improvement.

 **What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience is required.
* 5 years of experience handling an SCM team, with 3\-5 years in an engineering or supply chain environment.
* Strong technical knowledge of operational buying principles.

title: Utility Development Manager
description:
**About Mavria**
----------------


America invented artificial intelligence. Now we have to industrialize it.

  

AI runs on power, data centers, factories, equipment, supply chains, skilled labor, and the communities that host all of it. That physical layer now sets the limit on how far and how fast AI can scale, and whoever builds it fastest will lead the next industrial era.

  

Mavria is a strategic infrastructure company built for the intelligence age. We turn bottlenecks into products and systems we can build again and again, starting with Terrain, our manufactured data center platform. We move fast, and we believe infrastructure should leave the places that host it stronger.

  

We hire people who want to build the physical foundation of the AI era. If that is you, apply.

  

**How we build**
----------------

* **Reality wins.** Physics, equipment, contracts, and schedules don't care about our narrative. Start with what is actually true. Surface bad news early. Never manufacture certainty.
* **Own the bottleneck.** Find the thing slowing everyone down and make it yours until it's gone, whether or not it's in your job description.
* **Speed compounds.** Fast once is heroics. Fast every time is a system. Make every project leave behind a better standard, supplier, process, or playbook for the next one.
* **Earn the megawatt.** Earn the power and trust our projects require by leaving every community stronger than we found it.
* **Industrial patriotism.** Build American industrial capacity. Strengthen the factories, suppliers, skilled trades, and infrastructure the country needs to win.

--------------

* **Find real power.** Identify the utilities, substations, and load pockets that can deliver 5 to 25 MW to a Mavria site on a timeline that matters, and separate deliverable capacity from theoretical capacity.

title: Manager, Business Development & Project Management (Power Infrastructure)
description:
Company Description:


Hunt Energy Network (HEN), founded in 2018, specializes in delivering world‑class clean energy solutions. The company provides comprehensive support across the project lifecycle, from securing land leases and developing energy infrastructure to navigating the complex regulatory landscape of the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) power market. HEN develops and deploys advanced energy storage assets that supply ERCOT with a distributed, coordinated fleet of fast‑responding resources to help efficiently balance the grid. Its proprietary TraDER platform automates trading and settlement activities across the portfolio while optimizing project siting and asset performance. With nearly one in six BESS assets in ERCOT, Hunt Energy Network is among the market’s leading operators.


Position Summary:


Hunt Energy Network is developing large\-scale islanded (behind\-the\-meter) power campuses serving hyperscale AI data center loads, anchored by a multi\-hundred\-MW natural gas engine and BESS program currently in active development. This hybrid role pairs commercial origination with hands\-on project execution: the Manager will advance offtake and partnership opportunities for the islanded power platform while managing day\-to\-day development execution — vendors, permits, schedule, and budget — under the Vice President of EPC. The role also supports evaluation and execution of broader business development and M\&A opportunities across the Hunt energy platform.


Responsibilities:


**Business Development Responsibilities**

* Originate, qualify, and advance offtake counterparties (hyperscalers, data center developers, large industrial loads) for the islanded power package; manage teaser/CIM processes, NDAs, data rooms, and diligence responses.
* Structure and negotiate commercial frameworks — PPAs and power\-as\-a\-service offerings, build\-own\-transfer, JV, and asset sale structures — in coordination with legal, finance, and executive lead

description:

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment

title: Senior Energy and Utilities Manager
description: About Terawatt Infrastructure The once in a century transition to autonomous and electric vehicles is underway and will require a multi-trillion-dollar investment in energy and charging infrastructure, and the real estate to site it on. Terawatt is the leader in delivering large scale, turnkey charging solutions for companies rapidly deploying AV and EV fleets. Whether it’s an urban mobility hub, or a carefully located multi-fleet hub for semi-trucks, Terawatt brings the talent, capabilities, and capital to create reliable, cost-effective solutions for customers on the leading edge of the transition to the next generation of transport. With a growing portfolio of sites across the US in urban hubs and along key logistics and transportation corridors. Terawatt is building the permanent transportation and logistics infrastructure of tomorrow through a robust combination of capital, real estate, development, and site operations solutions. The company develops, finances, owns, and operates charging solutions that take the cost and complexity out of electrifying fleets. Our Values Six core values guide how we work: commitments we make to each other. Our pace is set by a simple conviction: imperfect action beats perfect inaction, so we move with purpose, adapt without ego, and measure ourselves by progress rather than activity. Ownership travels with autonomy. Your name is on the work, and the best answer wins the conversation, wherever it lives. That candor works because of what surrounds it: people who show up with intention and have each other's back, tough on ideas and generous with people. Our customers feel this as reliability earned daily, every interaction treated as a chance to build something lasting. And underneath it all is why the work matters. The climate doesn't wait, and the stakes are also human: behind every checklist and every inspection is a person going home safely. We call it "This work has a heartbeat” — it's what the other five rest on.
